feeds.title: HipHopDX
feeds.description: HipHopDX is the internet's #1 source for Hip Hop news, interviews, music & reviews. Find about Hip Hop music, Hip Hop news & all things Rap & Hip Hop.

feeds.title: EDM Identity
feeds.description: EDM Identity strives to provide quality content about electronic dance music and the culture that surrounds it in the US and abroad. This is established by keeping up with and reporting on the happenings in our community while simultaneously promoting companies and artists on the rise. EDM Identity also provides the unique opportunity of giving fans that make up our scene a platform to express themselves and showcase their own involvement in the community.

feeds.title: Chaospin
feeds.description: Chaospin aims to bring you the latest music news, music videos, breaking stories, trailer, technology, album releases, song lists, interviews, and more!

feeds.title: Aquarium Drunkard
feeds.description: Aquarium Drunkard is an eclectic audio blog featuring daily music reviews, interviews, features, mp3 samples and sessions. Digging globally, AD bridges contemporary sounds with psych, jazz, avant-garde, folk, garage, soul, funk, r&b and beyond.

feeds.title: Alternative Nation
feeds.description: Alternative Nation provide news on guitar based alternative rock bands that don't suck from the 90's onwards.

feeds.title: San Francisco Classical Voice
feeds.description: Find music news, artist profiles, concert and CD reviews, previews, a complete San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles concert calendar and much more.San Francisco Classical Voice (SFCV) inspires, engages, and informs audiences on the latest news in music and the performing arts.

feeds.title: Underground Hip Hop Blog
feeds.description: Underground Hip Hop blog is the Highest-ranked Underground Hip Hop blog worldwide. Stay updated with new music, albums, mixtapes, interviews, reviews & mic sessions.

feeds.title: Music Academy of the West Blog
feeds.description: Project Resonance Blog helps graduate students in music studies to produce engaging written and spoken materials for our audiences. Music Academy of the West is among the nation's preeminent summer schools and festivals for gifted young classically-trained musicians.

feeds.title: Music is 4 Lovers
feeds.description: Music is 4 Lovers is a media outlet, record label, online apparel store, and event brand dedicated to independent dance music. The blog section covers articles on music, interviews, premieres, labels, and new releases.

feeds.title: Disquiet
feeds.description: Disquiet focuses on ambient music and interviews with the people who make it. Marc Weidenbaum founded Disquiet.com at the intersection of sound, art, and technology, and has moderated the Disquiet Junto, an active online community of weekly music/sonic projects.

feeds.title: The Scenestar
feeds.description: Los Angeles-based music blog featuring news, band interviews, show and album reviews, set times and more.

feeds.title: A Strangely Isolated Place Blog
feeds.description: Ambient and electronica music news, reviews and features including guest mixes and interviews from A Strangely Isolated Place / ASIP.

feeds.title: Blurred Culture » Music
feeds.description: Blurred Culture's daily news section has become an important destination for those interested in the latest developments within the music community as well as other aspects of culturally-relevant content such as art, video, design and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Pass The Aux
feeds.description: Pass The Aux is an LA-based music blog mostly about discovery but covers a lot of other ground from festivals to news to features and a lot in between. It focuses on helping you discover new tunes. Check out the latest news, artist interviews, and more.

feeds.title: US Rocker
feeds.description: U.S. Rocker is an online destination that covers the best in pop culture and music from coast to coast and beyond.

feeds.title: San Francisco Community Music Center
feeds.description: Latest news, updates and announcements by San Francisco Community Music Center.The Community Music Center makes high quality music accessible to people of all ages, backgrounds and abilities, regardless of financial means.

feeds.title: Music Connection Magazine
feeds.description: Published in 1977, Music Connection magazine is a monthly music trade publication catering to musicians, industry professionals, and support services. Music Connection's award-winning magazine features reviews of new gear, unsigned artists, exclusive interviews with superstars, and behind-the-scenes talent.

feeds.title: Music 3.0 Music Industry Blog
feeds.description: An overview of music industry news and trends by best selling audio and music business author Bobby Owsinski. Music 3.0 looks at the new music industry and how social media plays a part in it.

feeds.title: Music in SF
feeds.description: Music in SF provides complete coverage of the San Francisco and Bay Area music scene. The magazine features interviews, concert reviews, and music news from both local and national music acts. Find out everything you need to know about the music scene in San Francisco.

feeds.title: SF Weekly » Music
feeds.description: Get the latest San Francisco Music news, updates, reviews, and more on SF Weekly. SF Weekly is your go-to publication for comprehensive coverage of San Francisco news, music, food, and arts scenes.

feeds.title: Monday Morning Music
feeds.description: J. Brian Craig is a minister, musician, and artist who loves God and his church. Brian posts regularly at his blog, Monday Morning Music. He shares what's going on in his musical life, posts free MP3s, videos, chords, lyrics, and shares spiritual background for songs.

feeds.title: Double Bass HQ
feeds.description: Jason Heath's Double Bass Blog has connected tens of thousands of musicians worldwide. With nearly 4,000 articles covering bass news, resources, and in-depth profiles, this site has pioneered an online community in the double bass world. His blog and podcast are highly regarded in the music world and have been featured as top offerings in the world of arts and culture for the past decade.

feeds.title: Pyramind Blog
feeds.description: Pyramid is an elite music and audio production school in San Francisco and Online. It offers helpful tutorials on electronic music production, mixing and mastering, arrangement and more.

feeds.title: D4 Music Marketing Blog
feeds.description: D4 Music Marketing is an online resource that focuses on music marketing, artist development and business education to empower aspiring and emerging artists who want to make a living off music as an independent.

feeds.title: Surfing Sound Waves
feeds.description: Surfing sound waves is the platform for online music discovery based in Venice, CA. SSW brings extensive coverage for both indie and pop music, giving voice to the best emerging artists and celebrating established musicians across all genres.

feeds.title: Casablanca Sunset Blog
feeds.description: Casablanca Sunset is a Los Angeles based music blog and record label imprint.

feeds.title: Labyrinth Music Blog
feeds.description: Laurel is an LA-area musician and music teacher. This blog is for music students, parents, teachers, performers, listeners, and anyone else. Covers articles on writing music reviews, tips to practice music, and advice for music students.

feeds.title: JamMob
feeds.description: JamMob Blog provides music marketing resources for independent artists.Our sole focus at JamMob is to help independent artists connect with fans and turn their passion for music into a successful career. We provide additional resources and training to help you promote your music.

feeds.title: Rap-Up
feeds.description: The latest hip-hop and R&B new music, news, photos, interviews, & videos.Rap-Up is the first nationwide hip-hop and R&B magazine for Gen Y and has featured some of music's biggest stars.

feeds.title: The Bay Bridged
feeds.description: The leading source for the best in San Francisco Bay Area independent music.The Bay Bridged is a nonprofit arts organization utilizing new media and presenting live events to support the San Francisco Bay Area's indie rock, folk, and pop music communities.

feeds.title: Hardcore Punk Rock Blog
feeds.description: Hardcore Punk Rock Blog shares hardcore music, podcasts, interviews, news and reviews.Punx In Solidarity has extensive knowledge of the punk rock underground. We are a committed and dedicated group of passionate punk rock music fans that enjoy the hardcore lifestyle.

feeds.title: American Pancake
feeds.description: The last true music blog covering indie music and the artists not covered by the Pitchfork medias of the world.American Pancake is a blog started by me, Robb, back in 2009.

feeds.title: POP On And On
feeds.description: Covering your pop music favorites while spotlighting emerging talent from newly signed artists to bedroom producers.
